description: This file defines a thread-safe wrapper for objects, including data structures, function pointer types, and function declarations for managing concurrent access, modifications, and futures.

classes.name: icThreadSafeWrapper
classes.description: A structure representing a thread-safe object wrapper with internal mutex and function pointers for managing object lifecycle and access.

classes.name: icThreadSafeWrapperFuture
classes.description: A structure representing a future for enqueued modifications, including synchronization primitives.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperAssignItem
methods.description: Manually assign an item to the wrapper.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperAssignItemIfReleased
methods.description: Assign an item only if the wrapper has been released in an atomic manner.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperReleaseItem
methods.description: Release the currently assigned item, allowing for safe concurrent calls.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperConditionalReleaseItem
methods.description: Conditionally release the item based on a check function.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperReadItem
methods.description: Perform a read operation on the wrapped item via callback.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperEnqueueModification
methods.description: Enqueue a modification to be performed once there are no active readers.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperModifyItem
methods.description: Perform a blocking modification once no readers are active.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperDoNotFreeContextFunc
methods.description: Helper for contexts that do not require cleanup.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperFutureDestroy
methods.description: Destroy a future object, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperFutureAwait
methods.description: Wait for a future to complete with timeout.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperFutureIsComplete
methods.description: Check if a future has completed.

methods.name: threadSafeWrapperFutureIsApplied
methods.description: Check if a future has been applied.
